summary: SMB1001 compliance now checks TM-03 antivirus and TM-07 Huntress coverage from the asset register, marks TM-08 compliant when the SPF, DKIM and DMARC best practice checks pass, treats VIP customers as meeting TM-01 and lets admins email an editable letter of engagement to ad hoc customers. The Legacy Essential 8 records button is hidden when there are no legacy records.
